description: This file contains unit tests for the OAuthClientAPI class, focusing on testing API endpoints related to OAuth client management, such as retrieving all clients, updating, fetching one, and deleting clients. It extends a test case class and uses data providers from YAML files to run parameterized tests.

classes.name: OAuthClientAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests the OAuthClientAPI methods related to OAuth client operations, utilizing data providers for parameterized testing.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all OAuth clients using a mock API endpoint and data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the testGetAll method from a YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an OAuth client, mocking the generateSecret method, with data from a YAML file.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the testUpdate method from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests fetching a single OAuth client by ID.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for getOne tests.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test case data for delete tests.
